comments.body:
It depends on your math level. The first year is realy about getting the basics settled. If you, like i did, needed more time to study you just gonna fall a bit behind every week. 
Myself i needed to work because my parents could only help me for insurances and lodgement, but i had to pay bills, food and else myself.
I then was like 4 weeks behind every semester and had to catch up in the learning phase. Meaning less time to prepare for the exams which is just such a huge stress.

So my personal experience, dont i you dont need to, but if you have to, only like 8h/week MAX
comments.author: ToboPotato
